title: Filipino Vegan Dal Curry
description: A creamy and flavorful Filipino-inspired dal curry made with red dal, onions, garlic, and spices, all vegan-friendly. Serve with steamed rice or roti for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add ground cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute.
Add soaked and drained dal, salt, and water. Mix well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until dal is cooked.
Use an immersion blender to mash some of the dal for a creamy texture.
Serve hot with steamed rice or roti.
